messages:
amanda: Quick sync — we need to finalize JSON mode validation + retry policy for next sprint. FinSuite wants strict schema enforcement + auto-retry on validation failure. Need tradeoffs before roadmap sign-off.

josh: +1. Do we mean server-side schema validation (reject) or try to auto-correct with retries? those are different UX/cost paths.

priya: From infra POV, retries = more tokens and variable latency. If we do auto-retries we should have a hard cap and observable counters.

ryan: Customer asks are understandable. Proposal: default = permissive validation (warn + best-effort parse), opt-in strict mode for enterprise with schema registry and a retry policy. That keeps hosted API fast for small apps.

sofia: Can we support a two-phase flow: 1) fast parse attempt with lightweight heuristics; 2) if heuristics fail and user requested validate:strict => retry with regenerative prompt + schema hints?

amanda: I like the two-phase flow. We should define concrete launch criteria: latency SLO delta <= 15% for permissive mode, strict mode documented as higher latency and cost. Also need rollout plan + flagging in SDKs.

josh: Implementation notes: runtime needs a per-request "validation_mode" param. Example: ```json
{"validation_mode":"permissive"|"strict","retry":{"max_attempts":2,"backoff":"linear"}}
``` Will require changes in request routing and metrics.

priya: Ops: please include counters for validation_failures, retries_attempted, final_outcome. Also a tracer tag so we can SLO-breakdown by validation path.

amanda: Launch acceptance checklist draft: 1) spec and SDK param docs 2) e2e tests with canonical schemas 3) metrics + dashboard 4) canary rollout to 5% of traffic + customer pilot (FinSuite) 5) clear billing note about retry token cost.

ryan: On prioritization: do we put this into this sprint or next? Engineering bandwidth is tight; maybe split work: SDK + spec first, runtime gating next sprint.

sofia: For schema registry integration (enterprise), we should design a lightweight manifest: schema_id + version + validation_policy. That keeps headers small.

amanda: Open questions I want resolved before product sign-off: - default policy value? - SDK ergonomics for retry hooks? - telemetry names and dashboard owner? - acceptable max_attempts?

josh: My vote: default=permissive, SDK hook = on_validation_failure(callback, auto_retry=true/false), telemetry names prefixed with "json_validation." , max_attempts default 1 (no retry) for hosted; enterprise can bump to 2.

product-bot: Reminder: linked PRD draft updated at https://redwood.internal/prd/json-validation (edited).

amanda: Action items: Josh to draft API param + example, Priya to stub metrics, Ryan to write rollout plan + FinSuite pilot invite, Sofia to propose schema manifest shape. We'll reconvene Thu 10am. :calendar:

ryan: Noted. I'll add canary gating: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 72h with automatic rollback threshold on regression.

priya: Also suggest a "dry-run" header so enterprise customers can see validation failures without impacting production. Good for rollout.

amanda: Great. Add dry-run to checklist. Thanks everyone — keep threads short updates here. :thumbsup:
